patch_description: The current program ties the reference (score 1.00, squared ratio ≈ 1/4.166) but takes 97s. Key parameters: seed family (D6 staggered rings scan), annealing temperature ladder (0.06→0.001), L-BFGS iteration caps, perturbation scales (0.015+0.012t), and pair-move polish steps. The new version: (1) uses a broader but still cheap structured seed set — D6 rings, twisted heptagon pairs (D7-like), icosahedron+poles, plus a few random starts; (2) keeps the annealed log-sum-exp L-BFGS ladder but trims maxiter per temperature so more restarts fit in the budget; (3) adds a ranked-neighborhood exact-ratio polish that perturbs ALL points involved in near-binding min/max constraints along random unit directions with decreasing step sizes (geometric 0.02→0.0001), evaluating the exact ratio each time and keeping improvements — this escapes the deterministic pair-move local optimum the previous version was stuck at; (4) an outer basin-hop loop of 30 perturb-reanneal cycles from the incumbent, each followed by the ranked polish. All improvements are guarded (only accepted if the exact ratio strictly increases), so the output can only improve over the previous 1.00-scored configuration.
